## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and behavior after this change.
Link the issue if there is one. Spanish and English are welcome.

## Validation

Commands run, OS/compiler and results. Identify anything you could not run.
For a bug fix, explain the regression case; for language changes, include an example.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe syntax/API changes, dependencies, known limitations and documentation updates.

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and does not include build outputs or secrets.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass with AXON_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON.
- [ ] New behavior is implemented; fakes are confined to tests.
- [ ] Applicable license and attribution notices are preserved.
